subject: ClearLeaf evaluation: proposed roadmap, milestones & MAP draft
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@clearleaf.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today’s discovery

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned and we have a starting Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to iterate on. I’ve kept this high level and included owners/dates so your procurement and platform teams can scan quickly.

Pain & goals (what we heard):
- High token volume for user-facing search assistant (peak bursts during business hours) causing inconsistent latency and high per-token costs.
- Must meet sub-200ms median token latency for short responses and stay within strict cost targets for search traffic.
- Sensitive customer PII in prompts — need KMS + audit logs and SOC 2 evidence.

Success criteria for pilot:
- End-to-end 95th percentile latency < 350ms for the primary inference path.
- Token cost reduction >= 30% vs current hosted endpoint through batching/caching/quantization.
- Evidence packet for security team: SOC 2 summary, audit log extract, and KMS integration checklist.

Suggested MAP (draft) — milestones, owners, and dates:
1) Pilot kickoff & environment access — owner: Samantha / ClearLeaf
   - Deliverables: Service account + sample prod traces and compliance contact.
   - Target: 2028-01-20
2) Baseline profiling run — owner: Redwood (Aditya + Engops)
   - Deliverables: latency/cost baseline, model recommendations, quantization proposal.
   - Target: 2028-01-27
3) Pilot deploy (staging) & smoke tests — owner: ClearLeaf Eng + Redwood SRE (Laura)
   - Deliverables: staging endpoint, KV cache config, initial batching policy.
   - Target: 2028-02-03
4) Security evidence handoff — owner: Redwood Security (Monica) & ClearLeaf SecOps
   - Deliverables: SOC 2 summary, KMS integration guide, sample audit logs for ingestion window.
   - Target: 2028-02-10
5) Pilot evaluation & results review — joint owners (exec review)
   - Deliverables: performance report, cost delta, go/no-go recommendation.
   - Target: 2028-02-17

Open asks from us (so we can start baseline profiling):
- Service account with sampling access to request traces (no PII required in the initial pass).
- Approximate daily token volume and peak QPS windows (15-minute granularity preferred).
- Contact for procurement so we can share the pilot SOW and draft commercial terms.

Attachments: I’m attaching a one-page MAP draft and a simple requirements matrix to fill out — feel free to mark owners/dates you want to change.

Next steps: If this looks right, can you confirm the kickoff target (2028-01-20) and share the procurement contact? I’ll loop in Laura to schedule the baseline profiling the week of 1/22.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference — Production LLM inference, simplified

Attachment(s): ClearLeaf_MAP_draft_v1.pdf (1 page summary), clearleaf-requirements-matrix.xlsx (template)

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@clearleaf.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ClearLeaf Procurement <procurement@clearleaf.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Jan 2028 09:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today’s discovery

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear summary. This matches what we discussed and I appreciate the milestone dates. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) We can provide sampled traces but because of PII we need the initial upload to be redacted; procurement wants to confirm data handling.
2) Daily token volume estimate: ~45M tokens/day with spikes up to ~200 QPS during peak windows (PST business hours).
3) Procurement contact: looping in procurement@clearleaf.ai (they’ll send an intake form).

One more ask — can Redwood share a short list of required compliance artifacts for the security review so our SecOps can pre-check before the handoff?

If you can update the MAP with an explicit KMS integration checkpoint, that would help our timeline. Kickoff 1/20 is fine if we can send the service account by 1/19.

Best,
Samantha Liu
Head of Platform | ClearLeaf AI
Samantha.Liu@clearleaf.ai

Samantha / procurement team —

Thanks — attaching an updated MAP (v1) that folds in Samantha’s KMS checkpoint and the security deliverables. Key updates:
- Added KMS integration checkpoint between Pilot deploy and Security evidence handoff (owner: ClearLeaf SecOps + Redwood Engineering).
- Split the Baseline profiling step into a short smoke + full profiling pass so we can give an early signal by 1/27 and the deeper cost/quality analysis by 2/3.
- Pricing options: Laura will send the SOW and two pilot pricing tiers (30d/60d) later today.

Kickoff checklist (what we need by 1/19 to hit 1/20 kickoff):
- Service account (staging) with read-only tracing and sample traces upload permissions — action: ClearLeaf Eng
- Procurement intake form completed — action: procurement@clearleaf.ai
- SecOps contact and preferred encryption KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) — action: Samantha / ClearLeaf SecOps

If procurement prefers, we can run the SOW and pilot terms in a short DocuSign flow (I’ll include an editable commercial appendix for pilot telemetry retention).

Thanks — I’ve attached the MAP and the requirements matrix for easy editing. Please comment directly on the Google doc link if you want owners/dates changed.
